---
title: "Early Career Network"
---

The Data Donation Early Career Network is for early-career researchers interested in exchange and networking around data donation. It started as a network of PhD candidates and now welcomes all early-career researchers.

The Early Career Network nominates two representatives to the network's [Steering Committee](about.qmd#how-the-network-is-organised), so early-career researchers have a voice in how the network develops.

## What we do

- An occasional newsletter by email
- A Slack channel for networking
- Workshops with input on data donation topics
- Meetups around conferences of interest to the data donation community

## Join the Early Career Network

Subscribe to the Early Career Network mailing list to stay in touch with other early-career researchers in the field.
